sources.title: DryVR: Data-driven verification and compositional reasoning for automotive systems
sources.review_notes: All 25 PDF pages (arXiv:1702.06902v1) were compared item by item with 190-dpi renders of the text block and with 330-450 dpi crops of the propositions, theorems, displayed formulas, the two algorithm boxes, Table 1 and the three figures, and with the authors' TeX source (section files, prelude1.tex macros, main2.bbl). Every page was rewritten by a per-page generator script: all inline and display mathematics is LaTeX from the TeX source with private macros expanded (762 math snippets; string comparison with the macro-expanded TeX leaves only 12 deliberate rewrites); the 6 extractor 'formula' images were replaced by display blocks, with \tag for the two printed equation numbers (1) and (2); Definitions 2.1, 2.2, 2.4, 2.6, 2.7, Propositions 2.3, 2.5, 2.9, 3.1, 4.1, 4.2, 4.3, Remark 2.8, Theorems 3.2, 4.4 and the three proofs carry their printed labels. Where TeX and PDF disagree the PDF was followed (the mode set printed as 'Ł', italic vlab/elab/lmap/sim). Algorithms 1 and 2 are image crops plus transcriptions; Figures 1-3 are image crops (edges measured on crops) with verbatim captions; Table 1 is a CSV read on a 330-dpi crop. Figure 2, Table 1 and Figure 3 were moved within their pages so that sentences crossing page breaks are not interrupted. The 56 references were generated from the .bbl, compared automatically with the PDF text layer and read on the renders. Additional checks: prose-run comparison with the TeX, per-page word-multiset comparison with pdftotext, per-page symbol counts. Omitted regions: the vertical arXiv stamp on page 1 and the page number at the foot of each of the 25 pages. Authors' typos and inconsistencies are kept and listed in the page review notes and in the conversion notes. Review was done by one agent; no independent second verifier was used.
